content.text: Characterized by engagement in unusual sexual activities &/or preoccupation w/ unusual sexual urges/fantasies for
acted on w/ a nonconsenting person
not considered disorders unless intense, recurrent, & interfere w/ daily life
•occasional fantasies normal component of sexuality (even if unusual)
DX: phallometric testing (penile plethysmography) assesses male sexual arousal, measure response to adult vs child content (sensitivity ≥55%, specificity >95%)
humiliated, beaten, bound, or made to suffer
observing unsuspecting person naked, getting undressed, or having sex
touching or rubbing against a nonconsenting person
Poor Prognostic Factors: multiple paraphilias, early age of onset, comorbid substance use, high frequency of behavior, referral by law enforcement after arrest
Good Prognostic Factors: only one paraphilia, self-referral for treatment, guilt over behavior, hx of otherwise normal sexual activity
↓ sex drive/fantasies: antiandrogens, long-acting GnRH, SSRIs, naltrexone
